name: Container
summary: The reading width of a website page: centred, capped, with side gutters that grow with the screen.

a11y.apg: Layout primitive, no role and no keyboard: it is a <div> that caps the width and centres it. The landmark is the Section or the <main> around it, not the container.

props.name: size
props.description: How far the content grows, by the names of the breakpoint scale: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280 (the default, one reference's max-w-container), 2xl 1536, or full with no cap (GAR-02, 06/10/2026).

props.name: children
props.description: The page content. The side gutter is --space-4 (16) on a narrow screen and --space-8 (32) from the md breakpoint up.
